displayName: INTAKE dev realm — COMMITTED DEV FIXTURE, laptop tier only. Synthetic users, dev-only-* passwords, .invalid mail. Never seed any deployed environment from this file.

authenticationFlows.description: files/08 §2.3 (INT-365): resume an SSO session, or a password and a second factor, each execution tagged with its RFC 8176 amr value. The api refuses a token without pwd plus otp or hwk, or without hwk for a role that reaches patient content.
Password (amr pwd), then the second factor. Both are REQUIRED and nothing sits beside them.

WebAuthn (amr hwk, user verification required) or TOTP (amr otp). An ALTERNATIVE needs a registered credential, so a staff account is enrolled through an admin-sent required action (webauthn-register or CONFIGURE_TOTP) before its first console login.
